claims.statement: For every finite ordinary tree U rooted at r, adjoining r-s-v gives I(T;z)=(1+z)I(U;z)+zI(U-r;z), alpha(T)=alpha(U)+1, I(T-v;z)=I(U;z)+zI(U-r;z), and the original new leaf v has summand Delta_(p-1)(I(U;z)-I(U-r;z)).
claims.scope: Exact polynomial, alpha, selector-polynomial, and new-leaf summand formulas for every finite ordinary U and distinguished root r; the new leaf selector is the strict rank-p test Delta_p(I(U)+zI(U-r))<0, with zero-extended integer coefficients.
claims.reason: retained: independent partition by membership of s proves the recurrence; degree and positivity prove the alpha increment; the original deletions for v are U and U-r, giving the stated summand.

claims.statement: The pendant-P2 recurrence and the checks in C2-T5 evidence do not alone establish the complete favorable-leaf sum inequality on the registered first-order shell; first-descent transport, every retained original leaf selector, and a global comparison of all original-tagged contributions remain unproved by this method.
claims.scope: Method-specific limitation for pruning a shell tree T of order 2p+2 to U of order 2p via adjoining or deleting a pendant P2, under the strict lower-region, first-descent, and fixed original-leaf selector definitions. This is not a refutation of the shell inequality.
claims.reason: retained_narrowed: order and alpha transfer are exact and the alpha guard has the stated one-unit reverse-boundary gap, but x can change (the exact K_(1,4) diagnostic has x(U)=2 and x(T)=3). Whole-tree recurrence does not determine old-leaf selectors or sum contributions; no eligible positive complete-sum witness or shell proof is supplied.

limitations: No universal shell proof or eligible positive complete-sum counterexample is established.
The K_(1,4) example diagnoses descent-index instability only and is not an eligible shell instance at the displayed rank.
The recurrence for I(T) does not determine selector changes and summand changes for all retained original leaf tags or their complete sum.
No tree census, external theorem, Lean build, or universal pruning reduction was performed.
